newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian parliament gets further file in sex probe.
newsitem.headline: Belgian parliament gets further file in sex probe.

text.p: The Brussels prosecutor general has handed parliament an additional report about Belgium's Deputy Prime Minister Elio di Rupo, who faces allegations of under-age sex, Belgian television said on Wednesday.
Parliament chairman Raymond Langendries called an emergency meeting of a special parliamentary commission on Wednesday which decided to hand the file on to Belgium's highest court.
The commission members did not look inside the latest report and there was no indication as to what it contained, television stations reported.
The court is currently investigating an earlier report by the Brussels prosecutor general containing allegations that Di Rupo had sex with under-age boys in 1989/90.

The court is due to return its findings to the commission by December 9. The commission will then decide whether the evidence against Di Rupo is strong enough to recommend he be indicted and sent for trial.
Di Rupo reacted to the news by repeating his earlier denials that he had ever been involved in paedophilia.

"My conscience is at peace," he said in a statement carried by the Belga news agency. "My confidence in our institutions is intact. I am convinced that no animosity can prevent the truth from triumphing."
